headline: An AI-made video that put South African rugby coach Rassie Erasmus into a famous movie car-singing scene, serenading the World Cup trophy, spread online in early October.
score_reason: Older news already carried on 5 Oct 2026 with no new facts, so the pool score of 2 is lowered by 1.
importance_line: It concerns rugby fans in South Africa and shows how easily AI puts a public figure into a film scene, but this entry adds nothing new to the early-October reports.
summary: South Africa's Daily Voice reported on 4 Oct 2026 that an AI-generated video swaps Springboks head coach Rassie Erasmus into the car-singing scene from the film White Chicks, where he sings Vanessa Carlton's "A Thousand Miles" to the Webb Ellis Cup, the Rugby World Cup trophy, and it calls the clip undeniably artificial. The video spread after the Springboks' 42-38 loss to Australia in Perth, and this is older news that we first carried in our 5 Oct 2026 edition.
notes: Pool item is IOL (blocked by Cloudflare). Text read from the Daily Voice article, the same source as the 5 Oct 2026 entry, so the url is Daily Voice's. Same story as 5 Oct entry 120; likely to be removed by the 14-day duplicate check.
